title: Longer LR warmdown at DEPTH=10
description: Changed WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.7 (longer cooldown, less time at peak LR), all else unchanged at DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.003814, slightly worse than the 1.002530 baseline. Combined with a2's round-0 result (WARMDOWN_RATIO=0.3 at depth=8 was worse too), this brackets both directions around 0.5 and suggests 0.5 is near-optimal for this schedule shape -- the warmdown axis is likely exhausted now, at least without also retuning depth or peak LR jointly. Switched away from my own proposed WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 experiment mid-round since a2 proposed the identical change (same value, same justification) -- rather than waste a slot duplicating it, I tested the WARMDOWN_RATIO direction that hadn't been tried at the correct DEPTH=10 width instead.
